reportTemplate.summary: Cancelled sales order {{v1}} as asked. The replayed procedure stopped before opening the cancel wizard, so I inspected the live page first: an accidental "Edit: {{v2}} Bench Customer" record dialog was overlaying a "Cancel Sales Order" wizard. I discarded the contact dialog (nothing saved) to expose the wizard, then clicked "Send and cancel", its confirm-cancellation button (the wizard shows "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?"). The record now shows stage "Cancelled" in the status bar (Cancelled radio checked, the other three stages disabled), reference still {{v1}} for customer '{{v2}} Bench Customer', and the Cancel button is gone (only "Preview" and "Set to Quotation" remain). Amounts unchanged: untaxed £1,615.00, Tax 20% £323.00, Total £1,938.00. The order is no longer active.

reportTemplate.summary: Opened sales order {{v1}} for '{{v2}}' and clicked the direct Cancel button. Odoo opened a "Cancel Sales Order" wizard asking "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?" (with an optional cancellation-reason field and subject "YourCompany Sales Order Cancelled (Ref {{v1}})"); I clicked "Send and cancel" to confirm. After cancelling, the record shows status "Cancelled" — the status bar radiogroup now renders Cancelled as the checked/current stage (Sales Order, Quotation Sent and Quotation all disabled), read from the live page via both the status bar text and the checked radio element. The reference is still {{v1}} and the two order lines remain on the record unchanged, but the order is no longer active. Side note: a system notification appeared in the chatter indicating the cancellation email delivery failed — this did not affect the cancellation itself.
